title: Quantitative Reverse Transcriptase-PCR Analysis
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v7ne9me

steps.title: Purify total RNA
steps.instruction: Purify total RNA using the RNeasy™ kit (Qiagen, Valencia, CA, USA).

steps.title: Reverse transcribe RNA to cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse transcribe 1 µg of total RNA using the QuantiTect Reverse Transcription Kit (Qiagen) for cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: Perform real-time PCR
steps.instruction: Conduct real-time PCR using the QuantiTect SYBR green PCR kit and primers purchased from Qiagen.

steps.title: Run qPCR and calculate expression
steps.instruction: Perform amplification and detection using a Rotor-Gene Q real-time PCR cycler (Qiagen), then calculate the change in expression of each target mRNA relative to the level of 18S rRNA.
